statement.ru: Шипы на хвосте стегозавра учёные называют словом из комикса.
statement.en: Scientists call the spikes on Stegosaurus's tail by a word from a comic strip.

why: 'Thagomizer' was coined as a joke in a 1982 Far Side cartoon and later adopted as an anatomical term.

statement.ru: Тираннозавр видел только то, что движется.
statement.en: A T. rex could only see things that moved.

why: A Jurassic Park myth; studies of its skull show unusually good binocular vision, likely better than a hawk's.

statement.ru: Дилофозавр плевался ядом в свою добычу.
statement.en: Dilophosaurus spat venom at its prey.

why: Venom spitting and the neck frill are fictional abilities invented by the Jurassic Park novel and film.

statement.ru: Бронтозавра больше ста лет считали тем же ящером, что и апатозавр.
statement.en: For more than a hundred years Brontosaurus was thought to be the same animal as Apatosaurus.

why: Riggs sank Brontosaurus into Apatosaurus in 1903; a 2015 study brought the genus back.

statement.ru: Трицератопс жил в юрском периоде.
statement.en: Triceratops lived in the Jurassic period.

why: Triceratops lived at the very end of the Cretaceous, about 69 to 66 million years ago.

statement.ru: Динозавры жили и в Антарктиде.
statement.en: Dinosaurs lived in Antarctica too.

why: Cryolophosaurus and other dinosaurs are known from Antarctica; dinosaur fossils are found on every continent.

statement.ru: Яйца гигантских динозавров были крупнее любых птичьих яиц.
statement.en: The eggs of giant dinosaurs were bigger than any bird's egg.

why: Even the largest dinosaur eggs are smaller than the eggs of the extinct elephant bird.

statement.ru: Первые люди застали последних динозавров.
statement.en: The first humans saw the last dinosaurs.

why: Non-bird dinosaurs died out 66 million years ago; humans appeared only some 300,000 years ago.

statement.ru: Велоцираптор в переводе — «быстрый вор».
statement.en: The name Velociraptor means 'swift thief'.

why: Velociraptor is literally 'swift thief' (Latin velox + raptor).

statement.ru: Настоящие велоцирапторы жили в Северной Америке.
statement.en: Real Velociraptors lived in North America.

why: Velociraptor fossils come from Mongolia and China in Asia, not from North America as the film suggests.

statement.ru: Динозавров погубил ледниковый период.
statement.en: An ice age wiped out the dinosaurs.

why: The extinction was caused by the Chicxulub asteroid impact (with volcanism), not an ice age.

statement.ru: Перья нашли даже у хищного динозавра весом больше тонны.
statement.en: Feathers have been found even on a meat-eating dinosaur weighing over a tonne.

why: Yutyrannus, estimated at 1.1 to 1.4 tonnes, is the largest dinosaur known with direct evidence of feathers.

statement.ru: Утконосые динозавры были беззубыми, как утки.
statement.en: Duck-billed dinosaurs were toothless, like ducks.

why: Hadrosaurs had hundreds of teeth packed into grinding dental batteries.

statement.ru: Цвет некоторых динозавров учёные узнали по окаменелостям.
statement.en: Scientists have worked out the colour of some dinosaurs from their fossils.

why: Preserved melanosomes show colour patterns, e.g. the banded tail and countershading of Sinosauropteryx.

statement.ru: При динозаврах сутки были длиннее, чем сейчас.
statement.en: In the time of the dinosaurs, a day was longer than it is now.

why: A 70-million-year-old shell shows days were about 23.5 hours; the Moon's tides have been slowing Earth since.

statement.ru: В Боливии есть почти отвесная стена с тысячами следов динозавров.
statement.en: In Bolivia there is an almost vertical wall with thousands of dinosaur footprints.

why: Cal Orck'o near Sucre: a near-vertical rock face with over 12,000 dinosaur tracks.

statement.ru: Крокодилы появились уже после вымирания динозавров.
statement.en: Crocodiles appeared only after the dinosaurs died out.

why: Crocodile relatives date back to the Late Triassic, about as old as dinosaurs, and survived the asteroid.

statement.ru: Хищный динозавр компсогнат был размером со слона.
statement.en: The meat-eating dinosaur Compsognathus was the size of an elephant.

why: Compsognathus was a small dinosaur, about the size of a chicken.

statement.ru: Учёные изучают окаменевшие какашки динозавров.
statement.en: Scientists study fossilised dinosaur poo.

why: Fossilised dung is called coprolite and reveals what dinosaurs ate.

statement.ru: Самые большие динозавры были хищниками.
statement.en: The biggest dinosaurs were meat-eaters.

why: The largest dinosaurs were the plant-eating long-necked sauropods.

statement.ru: В Канаде шахтёр нашёл динозавра, сохранившегося вместе с кожей.
statement.en: In Canada a miner found a dinosaur preserved along with its skin.

why: Miner Shawn Funk found the Borealopelta nodosaur at an oil sands mine in 2011, with armour and skin intact.

statement.ru: Тираннозавр мог прожить больше ста лет.
statement.en: A T. rex could live for more than a hundred years.

why: Bone growth rings show the oldest known T. rex, Sue, died at about 28 to 33.

statement.ru: Одного динозавра учёные назвали в честь Хогвартса.
statement.en: Scientists named a dinosaur after Hogwarts.

why: Dracorex hogwartsia, 'dragon king of Hogwarts', was named in 2006 with J. K. Rowling's blessing.

statement.ru: Огромный скелет титанозавра в нью-йоркском музее собран из настоящих костей.
statement.en: The huge titanosaur skeleton in a New York museum is made of real fossil bones.

why: It is a fibreglass replica printed from scans of 84 fossils; the real bones are far too heavy to mount.

statement.ru: Одного панцирного динозавра назвали в честь монстра из «Охотников за привидениями».
statement.en: An armoured dinosaur was named after a monster from Ghostbusters.

why: The ankylosaur Zuul crurivastator is named after Zuul the Gatekeeper from Ghostbusters (1984).

statement.ru: Динозавр ирритатор назван так, потому что учёных разозлила подделка черепа.
statement.en: The dinosaur Irritator got its name because a faked skull irritated the scientists.

why: Scientists were irritated that fossil dealers had altered the skull with plaster to make it look more complete.

statement.ru: Динозавры ходили, волоча хвост по земле.
statement.en: Dinosaurs walked dragging their tails along the ground.

why: Tail drag marks are almost absent from dinosaur trackways; tails were held up off the ground.

statement.ru: Шип с пальца игуанодона сначала посадили ему на нос.
statement.en: Iguanodon's thumb spike was first put on its nose.

why: Mantell placed the spike as a nose horn; better skeletons later showed it was a thumb.

statement.ru: В «Парке юрского периода» пробелы в ДНК динозавров заполнили ДНК крокодила.
statement.en: In Jurassic Park, gaps in the dinosaur DNA were filled with crocodile DNA.

why: It was frog DNA, which is also why the all-female dinosaurs could start breeding.

statement.ru: Скелет стегозавра продали на аукционе дороже 40 миллионов долларов.
statement.en: A Stegosaurus skeleton sold at auction for more than 40 million dollars.

why: The Stegosaurus 'Apex' sold at Sotheby's in 2024 for $44.6 million.

statement.ru: Люди живут на Земле дольше, чем жили динозавры.
statement.en: Humans have been on Earth longer than the dinosaurs were.

why: Dinosaurs ruled for over 160 million years; our species is about 300,000 years old.

statement.ru: В Китае настоящие кости динозавров толкли на лекарство.
statement.en: In China, real dinosaur bones were ground up for medicine.

why: In 2007 a village in Henan was found to have used dinosaur bones as 'dragon bones' for traditional remedies for decades.

statement.ru: Череп динозавра летал в космос.
statement.en: A dinosaur skull has flown into space.

why: A Coelophysis skull flew on Space Shuttle Endeavour in 1998, after a Maiasaura bone in 1985.

statement.ru: Первого динозавра учёные описали в XX веке.
statement.en: Scientists described the first dinosaur in the 20th century.

why: Megalosaurus was named by Buckland in 1824; the word 'dinosaur' dates from 1842.

statement.ru: В рычании рапторов из «Парка юрского периода» есть звуки спаривающихся черепах.
statement.en: The raptor calls in Jurassic Park include the sounds of mating tortoises.

why: The Velociraptor calls mixed tortoises mating with dolphins, geese, a crane and a human rasp.

statement.ru: Учёные когда-то думали, что огромные завроподы жили в воде.
statement.en: Scientists once thought the huge sauropods lived in water.

why: 19th and early 20th century studies held they were too heavy for land and must have been aquatic.

statement.ru: У микрораптора было четыре крыла.
statement.en: Microraptor had four wings.

why: Microraptor had long flight feathers on both arms and legs, forming four wings.

statement.ru: Астероид, погубивший динозавров, упал в Сахаре.
statement.en: The asteroid that killed the dinosaurs fell in the Sahara.

why: Its crater, Chicxulub, lies on the Yucatán Peninsula in Mexico, partly under the sea.

statement.ru: Скелет титанозавра в нью-йоркском музее не влез в зал: голова торчит наружу.
statement.en: The titanosaur skeleton in a New York museum didn't fit its hall: its head sticks out.

why: At the AMNH the 37 m cast's head and neck poke out of the gallery doorway toward the elevators.

statement.ru: Одного динозавра с хохолком прозвали в честь Элвиса Пресли.
statement.en: A crested dinosaur was nicknamed after Elvis Presley.

why: Cryolophosaurus's pompadour-like crest earned it the nickname 'Elvisaurus'.
